metadata.calibration: one disposable air world, camera translated toward one fixed panel
visual_notes: Inspected all 14 native marker A/B/C triplets and all 15 saved scene B/C pairs.
The panel remains recognizable at 24. Texture disappears at 30 through 48 while its native MapBlock and draw calls remain submitted.
At 52 the bounding-volume culler still retains the panel; its pixels equal fog color.
Surface View 3 has changed native Fog Color and substantial RGB difference. Native sky/fog and animation contributions are retained in the measured comparison.
Cave views 1,2,3,5 have pixel-identical B/C images. Underwater post-effect is identical in each B/C pair.

failed_native_attempts.reason: Cave observer moved down 0.5 block during longer draw-list settling
Repeated position updates used a lower precision feedback orientation
